description: Statistical Tables of China High Speed Railway and Japanese Shinkansen is a data set deposited in 4TU.ResearchData by its authors Xiaoyan Gu, K. (Kaihua) Lu. These data are the statistical tables of the current operating lines and transfer stations of China's high-speed railway and Japan's Shinkansen (up to the end of 2018). Data are collected from China's high-speed rail network and Baidu Japan Shinkansen inquiry. Coverage: several countries (CN, JP); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. Formats: Excel. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-4tu-repository.
